name: NRFF
definition: A method that uses the same radiance model as Ref-NeRF but proposes architectural improvements using multiscale tensor decomposition (MTD) and Anisotropic Spherical Gaussians (ASG) to encode view-dependent effects.
summary: NRFF encodes view-dependent specular effects in neural radiance fields by replacing positional encoding with Anisotropic Spherical Gaussians and a Rendering Equation Encoding function.
